rationale: WidgetBridge's JS prelude runs the handlers a native widget event reaches inside the existing __pulpRunHostCallback__ batching hook, so @pulp/react commits once per event, as it already does per frame and timer callback. Only the @pulp/react test that drives the shipped prelude changes under packages/pulp-react; the bundle and its runtime fingerprint are unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
tests: cd packages/pulp-react && npm run build && npx vitest run test/batched-host-callbacks.test.ts
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge fans window and document listeners out inside the event batch'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge keeps the propagation level a batched handler returns'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge native widget events run unbatched without a hook'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge runs a native widget event inside one UI batch'
